headword: {日経平均|にっけいへいきん}

definitions.explanation: Japan's best-known stock market index, calculated by the Nihon Keizai Shimbun (Nikkei) from the share prices of 225 leading companies listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Its movements are reported daily in the news.

examples.japanese: {日経平均|にっけいへいきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{日経平均|にっけいへいきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{下|さ}がった→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
⟦{円安|えんやす}→円安：04854_enyasu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧、{日経平均|にっけいへいきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{史上最高値|しじょうさいたかね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}した→更新する：27994_koushinsuru⟧。
examples.english: Helped by the weak yen, the Nikkei hit a new all-time high.

notes:
The full name is {日経平均|にっけいへいきん}⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧. News reports give it in yen, as in {日経平均|にっけいへいきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三万円|さんまんえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えた→超える：01942_koeru⟧ (the Nikkei passed 30,000 yen).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日経平均|にっけいへいきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上昇|じょうしょう}する→上昇する：21681_joushousuru⟧ / ⟦{下落|げらく}→下落：11321_geraku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: the Nikkei rises / falls
- {日経平均|にっけいへいきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{終値|おわりね}: the Nikkei's closing value
- {日経平均|にっけいへいきん}⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧: the Nikkei Stock Average (full name)

RELATED WORDS:
- TOPIX: the other main index, covering a much wider range of Tokyo Stock Exchange shares
- ⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧: share price
